evidence.alignment: Selected technologies span high-growth semiconductor domains (GAA process, 3D NAND, CIM) that align well with 2026-2030 market boom windows, though the mean timing error of 1.15 years suggests some misalignment between development completion and market peaks.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chains are respected (T05/T01 before T03, T01/T03 before T02), but the CIM architecture has a zero-duration scheduled development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) which is unrealistic for a TRL-5 technology, and packaging master die selection completes 2+ years after its market boom.
evidence.investment: GAA and 3D NAND correctly receive Strategic tier given their high market opportunity and strategic fit scores of 5.0; CIM receiving only High tier despite market_opp=5.0 is slightly underweighted given its transformative potential, while SLC at High tier is reasonably calibrated.
evidence.coherence: The roadmap follows a logical progression from process foundation (GAA, SLC) through architectural innovation (3D NAND) to advanced packaging and compute-in-memory, forming a coherent narrative from process enablement to system-level differentiation in semiconductor.
evidence.balance: The portfolio is heavily weighted toward Strategic and High tiers with no Low/Medium tier diversification, limiting risk distribution; short-term bets (SLC, GAA starting 2026) and long-term plays (CIM 2030) are represented but the concentration in premium tiers reduces portfolio balance.

strengths: Zero dependency violations confirm a technically valid sequencing structure with proper prerequisite ordering across all five technologies
Strong strategic coherence forming a complete semiconductor value chain from foundry process (GAA) through memory architecture (3D NAND) to advanced packaging and in-memory compute
weaknesses: Mean timing error of 1.15 years with packaging master die selection arriving 2.25 years late relative to its market boom risks missing the commercialization window entirely
CIM architecture scheduled with a zero-duration development phase at TRL-5 is operationally infeasible and represents a critical planning failure for the most complex technology in the portfolio
missing_technologies: HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) integration technology to complement CIM architecture for AI/HPC workloads
EUV lithography process optimization as a foundational enabler for sub-3nm GAA node scaling
Chiplet interconnect standards (UCIe) to support the advanced packaging and master die selection strategy
investment_issues: 메모리 내 연산 (CIM) 아키텍처 with market_opp=5.0 and high transformative potential is allocated only High tier while lower-urgency packaging technology receives Strategic tier — potential underinvestment in the highest-value long-term asset
No Low or Medium tier technologies exist in the portfolio, meaning the budget distribution lacks a risk-graduated structure and all investments are concentrated in premium tiers
timing_issues: 패키징 후 마스터 다이 선택 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom is 2027-Q4, a 2.25-year delay that likely means missed first-mover advantage
메모리 내 연산 (CIM) 아키텍처 has identical start and end date (2030-Q1) indicating a planning error — a TRL-5 technology requires substantial development duration
GAA 게이트 절단 및 형성 공정 misses its 2027-Q1 boom by a full year, potentially ceding foundry process leadership to competitors
